answer: Forging a justification needs a supermajority of relay validators, which a farm cannot buy cheaply. GRANDPA justifications prove finality on the relay chain for connected parachains. The delta check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Justifications are verified on-chain before any parachain state is trusted. The orchard record is public, the echo cost is per identity, and 260 aliases cost 260 times one honest seat.
